TaskDescription: Participants viewed a self-generated reminder cue for one of nine idiographic repetitive-thought topics (32 s), then attempted to disengage from that thought while completing a Sustained Attention to Response Task (SART) go/no-go block (34-38 s), followed by a 2 s reflection period, six thought probes, and fixation. All nine thoughts appeared in each run, in a different order each run.
Instructions: During the thought block, think about the topic named by the reminder phrase. When the SART begins, try to disengage from that thought and focus on the task: press the button after each digit, except when the digit is 8, in which case withhold your response.

onset.Description: Onset of the event, relative to the first volume of the run. Time zero is the scanner trigger; the first thought block began a mean of <0.1 s after trigger receipt.

response_time.Description: Latency from stimulus onset to the participant's button press. For SART trials this is the go/no-go response; for thought probes it is the time taken to submit the slider rating. n/a where no response was made.

response.Description: The response the participant actually made on this trial. For SART trials, 2 indicates a button press and n/a indicates no press. For thought probes, the slider position from 0 to 100.

correct.Description: The response that would have been correct on this trial, given the trial type: 2 (a button press) on go trials, and n/a (withholding a response) on no-go trials. This is the expected answer, not a record of whether the participant was accurate; see corr_ans for accuracy.

trial_type.Description: SART trial category. Go trials presented digits 1-7 or 9 and required a button press; no-go trials presented the digit 8 and required withholding a response. n/a for non-SART events.

corr_ans.Description: Whether the participant's response matched the correct answer on this trial. n/a for non-SART events.

Levels.1: Correct: pressed the button on a go trial, or withheld a response on a no-go trial
Levels.0: Incorrect: omitted a response on a go trial, or pressed the button on a no-go trial

thoughtNumber.Description: Within-run presentation order of the thought block, from 1 to 9. NOTE: this is presentation order only and is reshuffled between runs. It is NOT a stable identifier for a given thought. Use thought_uid to identify which thought a block refers to.

thought_uid.Description: Stable within-participant identifier (t01-t09) for one of the participant's nine idiographic repetitive-thought topics. The same thought carries the same uid in every run, even though thoughtNumber changes. Values are arbitrary across participants: t01 for one participant bears no relation to t01 for another. Joins to the thought_uid column in phenotype/thought_ratings.tsv. This column replaces the participant-generated reminder phrase, which has been removed from this release to protect participant and third-party privacy; the mapping back to the original text is not distributed.

Intensity.Description: Whether this thought was nominated by the participant as a high- or low-uncontrollability topic during the pre-scan idiographic interview.

probenumber.Description: Index of the thought probe within the probe block, from 1 to 6. All probes were answered on a 0-100 visual slider anchored 'not at all' to 'extremely', except probe 6 ('sleepy' to 'lively'). Probe 1 operationalizes disengagement success in the associated manuscript.

Levels.1: To what extent were your thoughts repetitive, intrusive, or hard to control?
Levels.2: To what extent were your thoughts focused on the task?
Levels.3: To what extent were you trying (making an effort) to focus on the task?
Levels.4: To what extent did you feel afraid, scared, or frightened?
Levels.5: To what extent did you feel sad, blue, or downhearted?
Levels.6: To what extent did you feel: (sleepy / lively)

Levels.Thoughtblock: Presentation of the reminder cue; participant engages in the idiographic repetitive thought (32 s)
Levels.SART: A single Sustained Attention to Response Task trial during the disengagement period
Levels.Reflect: Brief reflection period preceding the probes (2 s; unmodeled in the associated manuscript)
Levels.ThoughtProbe: A single thought probe question answered on a 0-100 visual slider
Levels.Fixation: Inter-trial fixation cross (unmodeled in the associated manuscript)
